subject: PromptFoundry x Redwood — integration liaison & technical discovery
body:
From: Ari Patel <ari@promptfoundry.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: PromptFoundry <> Redwood — integration liaison & technical discovery

Hi Marissa (and Vanessa),

Great to e-meet — I’m Ari, head of integrations at PromptFoundry. We build a prompt lifecycle platform (templates, versioning, evals) that a lot of ISVs plug into at model runtime. We’ve been experimenting with trace-level hooks and structured prompt telemetry and think there’s a clear win combining PromptFoundry’s prompt registry + Redwood’s trace & routing capabilities.

High-level ask: would Redwood be open to a small pilot to validate:
- programmatic trace injection via Redwood trace hooks (for prompt provenance)
- a lightweight SDK shim so PromptFoundry can capture model response metadata for evals
- a joint sample showing how prompt variations + routing policies affect cost/latency

We sketched an initial interop matrix (attached) and a proposed success criteria section (response fidelity, <50ms additional latency from trace shim, reproducible evals).

Proposed next step: 30–45 minute tech discovery next week. Can you share who on your side should be the technical liaison + any sandbox / API keys that we should request in advance?

Attachments: [Attachment: interop-matrix.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks,
Ari Patel
Head of Integrations | PromptFoundry
ari@promptfoundry.com
https://promptfoundry.com

--

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ari Patel <ari@promptfoundry.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: PromptFoundry <> Redwood — integration liaison & technical discovery

Hi Ari — thanks for reaching out and for the thoughtful matrix. PromptFoundry’s area is very complementary to what we see customers asking for.

I’m happy to coordinate a discovery meeting. On the Redwood side the best technical liaison will be Karthik (cc’d) — he owns partner integrations and trace hooks. Vanessa (partnerships) and I will join to scope success criteria and commercial fit.

Please see a short Redwood pre-checklist attached that outlines typical sandboxes/permissions we request for a small pilot. Could you share the following prior to the call?
- sample prompt bundle or template we want to instrument
- a dev sandbox key (or temporary tenant) for limited test traffic
- any SSO/KMS constraints we should know about

Suggested agenda (30–45m):
1) each team’s goals + success criteria (5m)
2) technical overview from PromptFoundry (10m)
3) Redwood trace hook capabilities & op constraints (10m)
4) pilot scope, milestones, and owner assignments (10m)

Proposed times: Tue 25 May 10:00–10:45 PT or Wed 26 May 14:00–14:45 PT — what works for your team?

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-integration-checklist.md (text)]

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of ISV Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Intro: PromptFoundry <> Redwood — integration liaison & technical discovery

Marissa — Tue 25 May 10:00 PT works for our engineering lead Sofia and me. We’ll send a calendar invite for 25 May 10:00–10:40 PT.

Sharing a short proposal that sketches the shim pattern we usually ship (attached) — it includes a small example SDK snippet, expected telemetry payload, and migration notes for customers currently using direct model calls.

We can also provide a temporary dev tenant (rate-limited) for the kickoff — I’ll include credentials in a secure note in the invite.

Attachments: [Attachment: pf-redwood-proposal.md (text)]

See you Tue 25th — sending the invite now.

Best,
Ari

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ari Patel <ari@promptfoundry.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: PromptFoundry <> Redwood — integration liaison & technical discovery

Ari — looking forward to Tuesday. A few quick pre-call asks so we can use the time efficiently: 
1) sample prompt payloads + one representative template you want instrumented (JSON or .yaml)
2) expected telemetry schema (fields + types) you plan to emit via the shim
3) high-level volumes: concurrent templates and tokens/sec in your dev tenant
4) any compliance notes (PII, retention, encryption expectations)

We’ll prepare a short demo showing: how to enable a Redwood trace hook on a route, the SDK shim pattern, and a minimal eval harness that compares response distributions across routing policies.

Also linking a HubSpot record and a short design stub we’ll attach to the meeting notes: https://hubspot.com/deal/PF-RED-2027-001

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Integrations Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
